content.thinking: Rejection: features didn't overlap. Fix: tuft ellipsoid centered lower / ensure side bumps overlap tuft and base. Base 16x16x2.5 at Z=0..2.5. Tuft: ellipsoid 18x10x11 rotated -25° about Y... leaning backward: rotation Y +? Keep rotation [0,20,0], center [0,0,7.0]. Lowest Z of rotated ellipsoid ~ 7 - half diag along Z. Rotated: half-extent z ≈ sqrt((5.5cos20)^2+(9sin20)^2)= sqrt(5.17²+3.08²)=6.02 → lowest ≈0.98 <2.5, overlaps base. Side bumps at [5,5.5,3.5] size 6x6x6: distance to base top? lowest 0.5 <2.5 overlaps base directly. Good — each feature overlaps base.

Fix: lower the backward-leaning tuft (center Z=7.0, rotated 20 deg about Y) so its lowest swept Z is about 1 mm, inside the 2.5 mm base thickness, giving solid volume overlap; and lower the bilateral feather bumps (center Z=3.5, radius 3 mm) so each directly overlaps the base (lowest Z about 0.5 mm). Both features therefore connect to the base with positive volume, producing one fused solid. Silhouette stays a soft, friendly duckling tuft in duck-yellow PLA, well under the 35 mm zone height and far from the camera face.
